component.name: solr
component.title: Solr
component.description: Index, search and delete documents in Apache Solr.
component.label: search,monitoring

connectionTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds that the clients that Camel creates wait to connect to Solr. The connectionTimeout option of an endpoint replaces it.

defaultCollection.description: The name of the collection, for the endpoints that set no collection.

host.description: The host name of the Solr server, for the endpoints that set their host to default. If not set, these endpoints use localhost.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

port.description: The port of the Solr server, for the endpoints that set no port. If not set, these endpoints use 8983.

requestTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds that the clients that Camel creates wait for the response to a request. The requestTimeout option of an endpoint replaces it.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

solrClient.label: advanced
solrClient.description: To use a custom org.apache.solr.client.solrj.SolrClient for all the endpoints, instead of a client that Camel creates for each endpoint. The solrClient option of an endpoint replaces it. Camel does not close a client that is set or autowired.

enableSSL.label: security
enableSSL.description: Whether the clients that Camel creates connect to Solr with HTTPS instead of HTTP. The enableSSL option of an endpoint replaces it.

password.label: security
password.description: The password for HTTP basic authentication with Solr, for all the endpoints. The password option of an endpoint replaces it.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The TLS configuration (key store, trust store, protocols, cipher suites, named groups) of the clients that Camel creates, for all the endpoints. The sslContextParameters option of an endpoint replaces it.

useGlobalSslContextParameters.label: security
useGlobalSslContextParameters.description: Whether the endpoints use the global SSL context parameters of the CamelContext when neither the component nor the endpoint sets the sslContextParameters option.

username.label: security
username.description: The user name for HTTP basic authentication with Solr, for all the endpoints. The username option of an endpoint replaces it.

CamelSolrOperation.description: The operation to perform: INSERT, DELETE, SEARCH or PING. It replaces the operation option, and a body that is a SolrJ request replaces it. Older values such as DELETE_BY_QUERY or COMMIT still work, and log a warning.

CamelSolrCollection.description: The name of the collection that the request goes to. It replaces the collection option.

CamelSolrRequestHandler.description: The path of the request handler, for example /update/json. It replaces the requestHandler option.

CamelSolrQueryString.description: The query of a search. It replaces a text body, but not a SolrQuery or QueryRequest body. When no operation is set, a message with this header is a search.

CamelSolrSize.description: The maximum number of documents that a search returns, which is the rows parameter of Solr. It replaces the size option.

CamelSolrFrom.description: The index of the first document that a search returns, which is the start parameter of Solr. It replaces the from option.

CamelSolrParams.description: The request parameters to send to Solr with an insert, a delete or a search. The headers with the CamelSolrParam. prefix add to them.

CamelSolrDeleteByQuery.description: Whether a DELETE takes the body as a query, or a collection of queries, instead of the id of the documents to delete. It replaces the deleteByQuery option.

Content-Type.description: The content type of a file or text body to insert, for example application/json. If not set, it is detected from the file or the text.

CamelSolrField..description: The prefix of the headers that carry the fields of the document to insert: the header CamelSolrField.id holds the id field.

CamelSolrParam..description: The prefix of the headers that carry extra request parameters: the header CamelSolrParam.commit holds the commit parameter.

producerIn.description: What the operation needs: INSERT a Map or a SolrInputDocument, a List of them or of @Field beans, a JSON array or XML text, or a file; DELETE the id or, with deleteByQuery=true, the query, as text or a List of text; SEARCH the query as text or a SolrQuery; PING does not use it. Convert bytes or a stream to text first. The CamelSolrField. and CamelSolrQueryString headers can replace the body

producerOut.description: The response of Solr as a Map (a SimpleOrderedMap) with the responseHeader and, for a search, the documents under response as a SolrDocumentList. Convert it to a QueryResponse or a SolrPingResponse to read it with SolrJ

host.description: The host name of the Solr server. Set it to default to use the host option of the component, or localhost when that is not set.

port.description: The port of the Solr server. If not set, the port option of the component is used, or 8983 when that is not set.

basePath.description: The base path of the Solr server. A path that starts with /solr/ sets the collection and the request handler instead: in /solr/products/update, products is the collection and /update the request handler.

async.description: Whether the producer sends the requests asynchronously. This needs a client that extends HttpSolrClientBase, such as the HttpJdkSolrClient that Camel creates; with another client the producer sends the requests synchronously.

autoCommit.description: Whether the producer adds the commit=true parameter to each request, so that Solr commits an insert or a delete at once.

collection.description: The name of the collection that the requests go to. The CamelSolrCollection header replaces this option. If not set, the defaultCollection option of the component is used, or the default collection of the solrClient.

connectionTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds that the client that Camel creates waits to connect to Solr. If not set, the connectionTimeout option of the component is used.

deleteByQuery.description: Whether a DELETE takes the body as a query, or a collection of queries, instead of the id of the documents to delete. The CamelSolrDeleteByQuery header replaces this option.

from.description: The index of the first document that a search returns, which is the start parameter of Solr (0 by default in Solr). The CamelSolrFrom header replaces this option. Not used for a QueryRequest body.

operation.description: The operation that the producer performs. The CamelSolrOperation header replaces this option, and a body that is a SolrJ request, such as a SolrQuery or an UpdateRequest, replaces both. If none is set, the body and the headers decide, for example a Map body inserts a document.

requestHandler.description: The path of the request handler, for example /update/json. An insert or a delete sends the update request to it (/update when not set), and a search sends it as the qt parameter. The CamelSolrRequestHandler header replaces this option.

requestTimeout.description: The time in milliseconds that the client that Camel creates waits for the response to a request. If not set, the requestTimeout option of the component is used.

size.description: The maximum number of documents that a search returns, which is the rows parameter of Solr (10 by default in Solr). The CamelSolrSize header replaces this option. Not used for a QueryRequest body.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

solrClient.label: advanced
solrClient.description: To use a custom org.apache.solr.client.solrj.SolrClient. When set, the host, port, basePath, username, password, enableSSL, certificatePath, sslContextParameters, connectionTimeout and requestTimeout options do not configure the client. If not set, Camel creates an HttpJdkSolrClient for the endpoint. Camel does not close a client that is set.

certificatePath.label: security
certificatePath.description: The X.509 certificate of the certificate authority that the client that Camel creates trusts for HTTPS. It is loaded from the classpath by default, or with the classpath:, file: or http: prefix. Not used when the sslContextParameters option is set.

enableSSL.label: security
enableSSL.description: Whether the client that Camel creates connects to Solr with HTTPS instead of HTTP.

password.label: security
password.description: The password for HTTP basic authentication with Solr, used together with the username option by the client that Camel creates. Not used when the solrClient option is set.

sslContextParameters.label: security
sslContextParameters.description: The TLS configuration (key store, trust store, protocols, cipher suites, named groups) of the client that Camel creates. It takes precedence over the certificatePath option. If not set, the global SSL context parameters are used when the useGlobalSslContextParameters option of the component is enabled.

username.label: security
username.description: The user name for HTTP basic authentication with Solr, used together with the password option by the client that Camel creates. Not used when the solrClient option is set.
